name: SCALE2c-rate-unread
note: the spread a tenth of the hub's own admission - the mints back inside a second or two

name: SCALE2c-no-cap
note: no cap: past the token's reuse a page's sockets no longer share one mint

name: SCALE2c-one-drop-a-wave
note: every lone drop held - a player's blip waits out a wave that never came

name: SCALE2c-window-unread
old: if (!wave || droppedAt == null || Math.abs(droppedAt - wave.at) > WAVE_WINDOW_MS) return null;
note: any drop held by a wave long past

name: SCALE2c-browser-unread
old: if (!online()) return t;   // the browser lost its network - a blip, not the relay's wave
note: a player whose network went held as if the relay had restarted

name: SCALE2c-offset-a-drop
old: if (drops.length >= WAVE_DROPS && !(wave && t - wave.at <= WAVE_WINDOW_MS)) wave = { at: drops[0], offset: rand() * waveSpreadMs(count) };
new: if (drops.length >= WAVE_DROPS) wave = { at: drops[0], offset: rand() * waveSpreadMs(count) };
note: a fresh offset at every drop of one wave - the page's sockets scattered, each minting

name: SCALE2c-slot-never-asked
old: const hold = this._dropAt != null ? this._wave.holdUntil(this._dropAt, now) : null;
note: the primary back at the old retry - the wave's mints at once again

name: SCALE2c-halo-not-held
old: const hold = h.dropAt != null ? this._wave.holdUntil(h.dropAt, now) : null;   // SCALE2c: the halo waits for the same slot, so the page mints once
note: the halo back before the page's slot - it mints, and the cell mints again at the slot

name: SCALE2c-count-never-noted
old: if (this.status === 'open' && isSocialRoom(this.room)) this._wave.noteOnline(this.othersHere + 1);   // SCALE2c: the hub's count sizes a wave's spread
note: no count: every wave spread over nothing

name: SCALE2c-busy-a-drop
old: h.dropAt = wasOpen && code !== CLOSE_BUSY && !noToken ? this._wave.dropped(this._now()) : null;
note: a gate's busy word counted as a drop - two refusals make a wave of nothing

name: SCALE2c-quiet-number
note: a zero read as nothing - a word this does not know, left unsaid

name: SCALE2c-quiet-object
note: a foe, a camp or a horse read as nothing

name: SCALE2c-own-counted
note: the frame's own bookkeeping counted as news - no frame is ever quiet

name: SCALE2c-never-said-once
old: skip(frame, { full, cell, room }) { return !!(cell && full && room != null && saidIn === room && quietFoesFrame(frame)); },
new: skip(frame, { full, cell, room }) { return !!(cell && full && room != null && quietFoesFrame(frame)); },
note: 'none' never said - a reader keeps the owner's last foe until its staleness sweep

name: SCALE2c-refusal-said
old: sent(frame, { full, room }, ok = true) { saidIn = ok && full && room != null && quietFoesFrame(frame) ? room : null; },   // a world room's quiet frame is remembered too - `skip` alone asks for a cell
new: sent(frame, { full, room }) { saidIn = full && room != null && quietFoesFrame(frame) ? room : null; },
note: a refused send remembered as said - 'none' never reaches the room

name: SCALE2c-skip-never-asked
note: every quiet full frame sent, as before
